prompt: Implement a class `LRUCache(capacity)` with methods `get(key)` and `put(key, value)`. `get(key)` returns the value of the key if it exists, otherwise -1. `put(key, value)` updates or inserts the value. When the cache reaches its capacity, it should invalidate and evict the least recently used key before inserting a new item. Both operations must run in O(1) average time complexity.

tests.test_basic_ops:
c = LRUCache(2)
c.put(1, 1)
c.put(2, 2)
assert c.get(1) == 1
c.put(3, 3)
assert c.get(2) == -1 # 2 was evicted
c.put(4, 4)
assert c.get(1) == -1 # 1 was evicted
assert c.get(3) == 3
assert c.get(4) == 4
tests.test_update_existing_key:
c = LRUCache(2)
c.put(1, 10)
c.put(2, 20)
c.put(1, 15) # update key 1
c.put(3, 30) # should evict key 2, not key 1
assert c.get(1) == 15
assert c.get(2) == -1
assert c.get(3) == 30
tests.test_capacity_one:
c = LRUCache(1)
c.put('a', 100)
assert c.get('a') == 100
c.put('b', 200)
assert c.get('a') == -1
assert c.get('b') == 200
